text:
Mia: Quick sync — finalizing the release announcement for Cascade tomorrow. Need: final changelog snippet, docs link, landing page URL + inbound lead routing, and confirmed canary timing. Also webinar + benchmark narrative coordination. Can we lock times so marketing can draft the post and email?

Sam: Changelog PR merged: https://git.redwood.local/pr/452 — small snippet below.
```
- Cascade release: improved KV cache eviction; p99 latency down ~18% on L96 workloads
- Added int8 quantized runtime option: ~2x reduction in GPU token cost (see perf notes)
- Bugfix: stable fallback policy for model routing
```

Priya: Docs staged at https://docs.staging.redwood.ai/releases/cascade — will merge to prod after canary pass. I'm drafting the "What's new" and the migration notes tonight.

Jordan: Inbound leads: we need the webhook endpoint and campaign UTM values to route folks into Sales queue. Also — canary window? Ops prefers Thu 09:30 PT for a 30m canary + 1h ramp if that works.

Alex: Webinar slot is locked for Fri 11:00 PT. Marketing needs the benchmark narrative and a short perf slide by EOD today for the slide deck. Can Sam confirm numbers for the new int8 variant (latency, cost delta, and stability notes)?

Sam: Kicking off perf runs now on a representative L96 workload. Should have a short numbers pack in ~2 hours and a CSV + TL;DR.

Priya: Suggested changelog blurb for email/post: "Cascade release: reduced p99 latency by ~18% on long-context workloads and reduced per-token cost with the new int8 serving profile." Approve?

Mia: LGTM — tiny edit request: replace "reduced per-token cost" with "reduced per-token cost (typical 2x improvement on inference bills)" so messaging is explicit. Make sure docs link and changelog snippet are included in the announcement email.

Jordan: Routing config example (send to CRM webhook + add campaign tags):
```json
{
  "campaign": "cascade-launch-2026",
  "utm_source": "announce_email",
  "webhook_url": "https://hooks.sales.redwood.ai/capture",
  "defaults": { "lead_owner": "ga_sales_team" }
}
```
I'll post this config to #sales-integrations and DM the webhook to @Mia.

release-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by Sam — Thu 2026-03-26T16:30:00Z (queued). Canary window: 30m, auto-ramp to 1h if metrics stable.

Sam: Ack — I'll monitor metrics and post results to this thread. @Jordan please share the webhook and I'll attach it to the release job.

Jordan: Sent webhook config to #sales-integrations and DM'd Mia. :white_check_mark:

Mia: Great — marketing will have the announcement draft + email ready for review by 5:00pm PT today. If perf numbers land earlier we'll inline them in the post and slides. Thanks everyone :rocket:
